event.title: Cuban Dissident Artist Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara Arrives in the US After Prison Release
event.canonical_title: Cuban Dissident Artist Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara Arrives in the US After Prison Release
event.summary: Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara, a prominent Cuban artist and dissident, arrived in Miami after being released from a five-year prison sentence. His release was contingent upon his exile from Cuba, following his arrest during the 2021 anti-government protests. Otero Alcántara is known for co-founding the San Isidro Movement, which advocates for artistic freedom and human rights in Cuba.

key_facts: Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara was released from a five-year prison sentence.
He was arrested in July 2021 during significant anti-government protests in Cuba.
His release was part of a condition for exile to the United States, where he received humanitarian parole.
